title: Vertebral fracture and amputation
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's vertebral fracture or amputation (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/20/2026
Reason for Admission: Traumatic amputation of right lower leg.

Hospital Course: 
Pt is an 83 y/o F admitted following a farm machinery accident resulting in a complete traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between the knee and ankle. Pt arrived in status post-emergency stabilization. Surgical team performed revision of the stump and soft tissue debridement. Post-op course was stable. Pt maintained RRR, CTAB, and WNL vitals. Pain managed with oral analgesics and PRN meds. Wound site shows good healing. Pt tolerated diet and mobilized with assistance.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between the knee and ankle

Discharge Medications:
- Acetaminophen 650mg BID PRN for pain
- Gabapentin 300mg HS

Follow-up:
F/u with vascular surgery in 1 week for wound check. F/u with physical therapy for mobility training.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/20/2026
explanations: Complete traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between knee and ankle, initial encounter: S88.111A (HCC 405).
